cover letter
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience and / or training.
Experience in Product Management or as a Product Owner.
Experience in driving a product enhancement roadmap and managing a product development life cycle for a product (content and technology preferred).
Experience creating business plans for products or enhancements.
Experience ensuring that organizational policies, practices, services, and behaviors support and promote inclusion and collaboration among staff.
Experience in implementing contracts with state education agencies and / or school districts.

The Product Manager at Smarter Balanced is responsible for Lifecycle Management, including driving the end-to-end product strategy, requirements, and long-term integration roadmap for Tools for Teachers and assigned applications, while navigating complex variable factors and technical trade-offs.

The incumbent partners closely with consortium members to build deep insights into diverse user personas and needs, translating member requirements into solutions that elevate user satisfaction and deliver measurable educational impact. Internally, the position guides cross-functional and matrixed teams to successfully deliver high-impact products and enhancements on scope, schedule, and budget.
In your most recent position, engaged in work necessary to address the terms of a contract either as a direct service provider or part of an organization that provides products and services.
Advanced understanding of how products and programs relate to the overall business strategy.
Advanced knowledge of the education market and a track record of understanding the needs of educational customers.
Proven ability to research, collect and analyze information to use in determining product options or alternatives.

Advanced knowledge of product management and development concepts, practices, standards and processes (requirements gathering, user personas, competitive analysis, road mapping, software development life cycle).
Advanced organization and project management skills to lead large or multiple cross-functional teams.
Advanced oral communication skills to effectively present, negotiate, convey and explain information.
Advanced written communications skills to draft clear, concise documentation, reports and specifications.
Thorough knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and feature/roadmap management software.
Proven ability to identify key issues critical to the organization's long-range success of a desired product or service.
Ability to lead, build consensus and promote the exchange of information among project team, internal and external constituencies. Leadership through influence skills.
